Package org.apache.juneau.commons.svl

Class Structure

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.svl.Structure
public final class Structure extends Object
A typed, structured value (list, block or table) that an SVL expression function can return.

The core never emits markup. toString() gives a plain-text fallback; a layer that understands richer output (such as the J0439 template layer) interprets kind(), items() / rows() and options() itself.

Instances are immutable; all inputs are defensively copied (shallow: the elements themselves are not copied).

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Plain-text fallback.

      Lists render one item per line prefixed with - or N. ; a block renders its content; a table renders the header and then each row as tab-separated values, one per line.
